commit.message:
direct: default OpenAI model to gpt-5.5

gpt-5.5 (latest) lands valid + lint-clean in fewer attempts than o4-mini and
with zero advisories (gap-free, butt-joined scenes) on the 18s test. It routes
through the existing reasoning-model path (gpt-5* prefix). o4-mini remains a
cheaper fallback via --model / OPENAI_MODEL.
